senses.gloss:
पौरव १

PAURAVA I . An ancient Rājarṣi. He became Parvatarāja when he grew up after being born of the species of the daitya, śarabha. Once arjuna defeated this king. The pāṇḍavas invited him for the mahābhārata battle. But he did not accept it but joined sides with the kauravas against the pāṇḍavas. paurava was considered a prominent commander in the kaurava army. In the kurukṣetra battle he at first fought against dhṛṣṭaketu and then was wounded when he fought against abhimanyu. It was arjuna who killed him in the end. (Chapter 67, Ādi Parva; Chapter 27, Sabhā Parva; Chapters 4, 128, Udyoga Parva; Chapter 116, bhīṣma parva; Chapter 14, droṇa parva; Chapter 5, karṇa Parva).

पौरव २

PAURAVA II . Those born in the puru line of kings are as a class called Pauravas. Both kauravas and pāṇḍavas have been mentioned as Pauravas in the Purāṇas. (Chapter 172, Ādi Parva).

पौरव ३

PAURAVA III . An ancient king of the kingdom of aṅga. This paurava was also one among the kings who gave money to king sṛñjaya when he conducted an aśvamedha (Chapter 57, droṇa parva).

पौरव ४

PAURAVA IV . One of the Brahmavādī sons of viśvāmitra. (Śloka 55, Chapter 4, anuśāsana parva).

पौरवक

PAURAVAKA . A kṣatriya tribe. These people fought against the kauravas joining the krauñcavyūha constructed by dharmaputra in the great battle. (Chapter 50, bhīṣma parva).

पौरवी १

PAURAVĪ I . Wife of vasudeva, father of śrī kṛṣṇa He had many other wives. (9th skandha, bhāgavata).

पौरवी २

PAURAVĪ II . Wife of yudhiṣṭhira. yudhiṣṭhira begot a son named devaka of pauravī. (9th skandha, bhāgavata).

पौरुषेय

PAURUṢEYA . A demon who travels along with the sun in the month of jyeṣṭha. (June), (11th skandha, bhāgavata).

पौरिक

PAURIKA . A king of the ancient country Purikānagarī. He was such a sinner that he was reborn as a jackal in his next birth. (Chapter 111, śānti Parva).

पौर्णमास

PAURṆAMĀSA . Son of marīci. His mother was called sambhūti. paurṇamāsa had two sons named virajas and parvata. (Chapter 10, aṁśa 1, viṣṇu purāṇa).
